item.title: “Poison De Rahe Ho”: Dead Rat Found in Curd at Ghazipur Dhaba, Authorities Seal Eatery After Video Goes Viral
item.description: Ghazipur authorities sealed a popular highway restaurant after a customer found a dead rat in curd.

item.title: Paralysed Kanpur Husband Brought on Stretcher to Court in Wife’s Maintenance Case: Watch
item.description: A bedridden man's undignified court appearance on a stretcher highlights shocking gaps in accessibility for the disabled amid a bitter family dispute.

item.title: Bangladesh Horror: Hindu Man Dipu Chandra Das Lynched, Body Burnt in Mymensingh; 7 Arrested
item.description: Bangladesh arrests 7 for lynching Hindu man over blasphemy as Hadi assassination sparks nationwide protests.

item.title: Indian Railways Announces Train Fare Hike From Dec 26, AC & Express Travel Gets Slightly Costlier; All You Need to Know
item.description: Indian Railways will hike passenger fares for AC and Express trains starting December 26 to manage rising costs. Know more.

item.title: Victory Celebration Turns Tragic in Pune’s Jejuri as Fire Injures 16, Including NCP Councillors
item.description: A post-poll victory celebration in Jejuri, Pune, turned deadly when a colour-spray fire injured 16 revellers.

item.title: 16-Year-Old Disabled Boy Beaten with Pipe, Chilli in Eyes at Bagalkot School; 4 Arrested, Facility Sealed
item.description: Leaked video shows couple, staff beating 16-year-old disabled boy at unlicensed Karnataka school; arrests, shutdown follow outrage.

item.title: VB-G RAM G Bill Becomes Law After President’s Nod, Rural Job Guarantee Raised; Opposition Sparks Debate
item.description: The new VB‑G RAM G law boosts guaranteed rural workdays while reshaping funding, planning and digital monitoring, sparking both optimism and concern among stakeholders.

item.title: Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami Makes Bhagavad Gita Recitation Mandatory in All Schools
item.description: Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami has mandated Bhagavad Gita recitation in schools to boost moral values and cultural awareness.

item.title: Divyang Runner’s Unbreakable Spirit Lights Up Record-Breaking 10th Tata Steel World 25K
item.description: A divyang runner's resilient participation highlighted inclusivity at the record 23,000-participant 10th Tata Steel World 25K Kolkata, won by Uganda's Stephen Kissa.

item.title: Shocking Video Shows Rats Inside Newborn Care Unit at Madhya Pradesh Govt Hospital, Triggers Outrage
item.description: Shocking video footage shows rats scurrying over medical equipment in a Satna newborn care unit, sparking a hygiene crisis.
